items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] But, uh, Mr. Paul Goliere, you know. Yeah, he should know too.

ctx.x: He can't remember that part back.
But, uh, Mr. Paul Goliere, you know. Yeah, he should know too. He said he thought they came from Mexico. He studied with the Tio.

Well, if he told you, well... He should know. Well, he should know, yeah. Yeah. His sister used to teach me, you know. I said, take lessons, I'll just go to... We call him Guy Kelly, but his right name is Edgar Kelly. Guy Kelly.
